newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks higher at start.

text.p: U.S. stocks, taking their cue from a steady bond market, moved higher at the start on Tuesday after breaking a nearly week-long losing streak on Monday.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 10 at 6,929, the Nasdaq Composite six higher at 1,317 and the S&P Index up fractionally at 796.
The 30-year long bond was up 6/32 to yield 6.82 percent.
